newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,845 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,845 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,845 contracts compared with 1,716 overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 21 wheat, 390 corn, 976 soybean, 234 soymeal, 156 soyoil, 38 soybean calls and 30 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one to six cents higher, corn was steady to 1/2 cent lower and soybeans were one to 5-1/2 cents higher.
